content: MK cites two letters as evidence of open communication between occult philosophers like Ibn Turka and practitioners of the 'legitimate' sciences: one in MS Majlis 10196 f. 153b from Qāżīzāda Rūmī, director of Ulugh Beg's observatory in Samarkand, and letter no. 31 sending greetings to the astronomer Badr al-Dīn in Gilan.
refers_to_primary: Munshaʾāt-i Turka, letter 31; MS Majlis 10196 f. 153b
